description: The negative control for props_corpus (tests/props_corpus.cpp): cases in props/documents.json's shape whose expectations are DELIBERATELY WRONG. props_corpus_negative passes only when the runner reports every one as differing and the run as failed. One case, through the props.reader session.
sources: hand-written; each case is core's (conformance/props/documents.json) with one expected value changed, named by its new name

contract.kind: kind, else textCategory (each must be one of kinds), else a NoticeArticle: documentType story or poem is book, anything else notice
contract.pages: authored pages (a non-empty array of {content, contentTranslation?}) are kept; otherwise body (else text) is paginated, each page with contentTranslation '', except that a single page carries bodyTranslation; a paginated body of more than one page keeps bodyTranslation whole in translation
contract.paginate: a charsPerPage that is not a whole number >= 1 is defaultCharsPerPage (documentOf refuses it first); windows of charsPerPage UTF-16 code units; a window short of the end breaks after the last space or newline at an index from its end down to start + floor(charsPerPage / 2); pages trimmed; a page empty after trimming is dropped; no page at all is one empty page
contract.cefr: cefrLevel when non-empty, else difficulty beginner A1, intermediate A2, advanced B1 (difficultyToCefr), else null
contract.questions: comprehensionQuestions, else the one comprehensionQuestion; a question whose correctIndex is not an index of its options is dropped; the reader asks the first
contract.vocabulary: vocabularyHighlights {word, translation}, else vocabularyWords {word, meaning}; an entry with no word is dropped
contract.sign: kind sign: never collectible, readingXp 0, no questions
contract.reader: reading: prev moves back (not below 0); next moves on; next on the last page is Done: document_read, then (unless alreadyRead) document_collected when collectible and reading_xp when > 0, then vocabulary_added and clue_discovered when there are any; then quiz when a question is asked (none when alreadyAnswered), else closed with document_closed. quiz: answer {index} once -> question_answered {correct, xp: quizXp or 0}, phase answered. close at any phase but closed -> document_closed. Refusals: closed (any action once closed), not_reading (prev/next outside reading), not_quiz, bad_index, unknown_action

cases.name: read: expected WRONGLY page 2 after next on a two-page document
